target_customer: Engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs of engineering) at software companies who must explain engineering work to the business
problem: Engineering leaders cannot easily show how engineering effort lines up with business goals or whether deliveries had business impact, which makes hiring, priority and reporting decisions harder.

founders.name: Arnaud Porterie
prior_employers: Docker (Senior Engineering Manager, led the Docker Engine team)
founders.background_notes: Sources: YC company page and the company's own Sept 2022 blog post. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Jellyfish
competitors.what: Engineering management platform aligning engineering work with business objectives
competitors.funding_then: Series B of $31.5M led by Insight Partners, after a $12M Accel-led Series A in 2020

competitors.name: LinearB
competitors.what: Software delivery analytics and workflow tooling for dev teams
competitors.funding_then: $16M Series A in March 2021 led by Battery Ventures (Sacra figure $16.1M)

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly integrations with git and ticketing tools plus reporting, standard SaaS work for a small team; no hard research problems.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals already sold similar dashboards, and the product depends on connectors any rival could build; the intent layer is the only differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded engineering analytics vendors were already selling to the same buyer in 2021; no source found of an incumbent copying or buying Echoes.

market_need_then: Engineering leaders were adopting engineering management platforms in 2021, shown by Jellyfish and LinearB raising rounds in early 2021, so the reporting pain was funded and visible.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Developer friendly, per the company's own blog mission statement

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself was found; only directory listings.

outcome_analysis: Echoes stayed a three person company in Amsterdam with no verified funding beyond the YC deal and no reported exit or shutdown. It launched its product in September 2021 and a Product Hunt launch followed in May 2023. The market already had better funded engineering analytics vendors, so it has not shown venture scale growth in public sources.
notes: Round added: Seedtable lists about 125K pre-seed in 2021 with one unnamed investor, a single database entry; Village.ai gives the same total. Nordic9 dates a raise 2021-12-09 with no amount and names investors that no second source confirmed, so they are not recorded. Company site echoeshq.com returned HTTP 404 on fetch. One CB Insights entry listing AngelList and Bossa Invest likely belongs to a different company. Competitors were not named by Echoes itself; they are category incumbents with dated funding news. Product Hunt page shows a launch dated 2023-05.
